name: Ditto
dexEntry: Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this Pokémon manages to get details wrong.

forms.name: Eerie
forms.dex: ''The truth is... We may never know what the White Ditto is, where it came from, or why certain things seem to happen when it is involved. We do not even know if it is every copy of Blue Version or if it only rests in a select few... But what we do know is that there is a story out there. We just have to find it, and put the pieces together.''
